snippet.title: LCD Longplay - GoldenEye (Tiger Electronics 1995)
snippet.description:
Today, on LCD Longplay, we play through the 1995 Tiger Electronics release of GoldenEye.

CONTROLS
Besides the directional buttons, the handheld has four other action buttons for use in the game: one to shoot, one to kick, one to punch, and one to use Q's secret weapons.

Which LCD game would you like to see played through next?

Send me an E-Mail and let me know how you're doing, what you've been playing, or just anything at all :)
